tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for agreeing to participate. I'd like to ask you some questions about exercise programs. First, do you think exercising daily is important for good health? Why or why not?
tasks.sample: Absolutely, yeah! I think working out every day is super important, mainly because it boosts both physical and mental health. Like, even just 30 minutes of walking or yoga keeps your heart strong and reduces stress. Plus, it gives you energy and improves your mood. If you skip it, you might feel sluggish or get sick easier. So yeah, daily exercise is key for staying healthy long-term.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您同意参与此次调查。我想向您询问一些有关锻炼计划的问题。首先，您认为每天进行锻炼对保持健康是否很重要？为什么呢？还是为什么不是呢？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you. Imagine you are going to recommend or create an exercise program for a friend or family member who does not currently exercise. What kind of exercise or fitness routine would you recommend? Why?
tasks.sample: I'd suggest starting with brisk walking or light jogging. Why? Cause it's easy, free, and you can do it anywhere—no gym needed! For a beginner, consistency matters more than intensity. I'd tell my friend: Just walk 20 minutes a day, maybe with a podcast.' It builds stamina without feeling overwhelming. Once they're used to it, we could add fun stuff like dancing or biking to keep it fresh.
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢你！假设你要为一位目前不进行锻炼的亲友推荐或制定一个锻炼计划。你会推荐什么样的锻炼方式或健身方案呢？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. For that same friend or family member, what do you think might challenge them the most about a regular exercise program? How would you help them through this challenge?
tasks.sample: Honestly, sticking to a routine is the toughest part. Life gets busy, and motivation fades fast. To help, I’d be their accountability partner—like texting them ‘Did you walk today?’ or joining them on weekends. Also, I’d suggest tracking progress with a simple app; seeing small wins keeps you going. If they’re tired, we’d switch to shorter workouts. The key is flexibility, not perfection.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。对于同样的朋友或家人成员而言，你觉得对于他们来说，常规锻炼计划中最可能遇到的挑战是什么？你会如何帮助他们克服这个挑战呢？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great. Some people believe that it is important to have some sort of reward after a good week of exercising. What do you think would be a good reward for the program you created and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：太好了。有些人认为，在进行了一周良好的锻炼之后，获得某种形式的奖励是很重要的。那么对于你所设计的这个项目来说，你觉得什么样的奖励会是合适的呢？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
